text:
Controlling for inflation and PPP, Japan's GDP per capita increased by about 5-fold from 1950 to 2016, from roughly $3,000–4,000 to about $38,000–40,000 in 2011 international dollars. This is closer to 5-fold than 20-fold, since a 20-fold rise would imply an implausibly high 2016 level.  
CONFIDENCE: 85
